 Order
With the consent of the parties, heard finally at motion stage.

2. This appeal has been filed by the appellants under Section 173 (1) of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 against the award dated 26.10.2021 passed in MACC No.01/2019 by Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Rewa seeking setting aside of impugned award and grant of suitable compensation.
3. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
4. Perusal of the impugned award reveals that Tribunal has dismissed the claim petition of the appellants but it has not decided all the issues on merits.
Therefore, case is remitted back to the Tribunal with a direction to decide all those issues on merits on the basis of evidence available on record, which it has not decided on merits.
5. With the aforesaid observations, this appeal is disposed off.
6. Parties are directed to appear before the Tribunal on 2.7.2024.
(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE Hashmi Prema Saket vs Pintu @ Harish Kumar Pandey
